exact: neutrophil programmed cell death by apoptosis
programmed cell death of neutrophils by apoptosis

definition: Any apoptotic process in a neutrophil, any of the immature or mature forms of a granular leukocyte that in its mature form has a nucleus with three to five lobes connected by slender threads of chromatin, and cytoplasm containing fine inconspicuous granules and stainable by neutral dyes.
label: neutrophil apoptotic process
